verdict.rationale: The pack shows GoDaddy stores account, contact, and commerce customer data and even notes API usage counts are 'retained for three months' (godaddy-docs-37), but nowhere does it document a user-facing mechanism to control or delete retention of personal/account/API data, especially for AI-driven usage via MCP or the gddy CLI. No privacy policy, data export, or deletion-request workflow is evidenced.
